About.title: Modern Building For Engineering Consultancy (MBEC)
About.subtitle: Established in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia with an uncompromising commitment to structural integrity, human safety, and regulatory excellence.
About.overviewP1: Modern Building For Engineering Consultancy (MBEC) is a premier KSA-based engineering consultancy specializing in Fire and Life Safety (FLS) system design, building code compliance, and Civil Defense approval services.
About.overviewP2: In full alignment with the Saudi Building Code (SBC 201/801), NFPA, IFC, and IBC standards, MBEC collaborates closely with private developers, public ministries, and regulatory bodies such as the General Directorate of Saudi Civil Defense, MODON, and the Royal Commission.
About.visionText: To stand as the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia's foremost Fire and Life Safety engineering consultancy, recognized for benchmark technical rigor, engineering innovation, and institutional trust.
About.missionText: To safeguard human life, national assets, and built infrastructure through unyielding adherence to codes, optimized value engineering, and seamless regulatory licensing.
About.chairmanMessage: Under the leadership of Chairman Eng. Anmar Al Qureshi and Executive Director Eng. Mohammad Almaayh, MBEC has spearheaded safety benchmarks for major developments across Jeddah, Riyadh, Makkah, Abha, and the Kingdom.
About.codesSubtitle: Every blueprint, calculation, and hydraulic simulation engineered by MBEC complies rigorously with international and national safety mandates:

Services.title: Specialized Engineering Disciplines
Services.subtitle: Comprehensive technical engineering across core fire protection, detection, architectural life safety, smoke control, ventilation, pressurization, and computational fluid dynamics.
Services.scopeNote: Note: The final scope for each system shall be defined based on the project type, design stage, available drawings, client requirements, and the applicable codes and authority requirements.
Services.ctaTitle: Need a Comprehensive Code Compliance Review?
Services.ctaSubtitle: Our certified engineering consultants review architectural blueprints, hydraulic calculations, and Salamah licensing submissions to eliminate delays.

fireProtection.title: Fire Protection System
fireProtection.description: Design and review of fire protection systems, including automatic sprinkler networks, fire hose reels and cabinets, portable fire extinguishers, foam or clean-agent systems where required, fire pumps and water storage tanks, hydraulic calculations, drawings, and bills of quantities, in accordance with applicable codes and authority requirements.
points: Automatic sprinkler networks & pipe sizing
Fire hose reels, cabinets & portable extinguishers
Specialized foam & clean-agent gaseous suppression
Fire pumps, water storage tanks & hydraulic calculations

fireAlarm.title: Fire Detection and Alarm System
fireAlarm.description: Design and review of fire detection and alarm systems, including fire alarm control panels, smoke, heat, flame, and gas detectors where required, manual call points, audible and visual notification appliances, monitoring and control modules, system zoning, cause-and-effect matrix, and interfaces with fire protection and related electromechanical systems.
points: Fire alarm control panels & intelligent detector networks
Manual call points, audible & visual notification appliances
System zoning & comprehensive cause-and-effect matrix
Interfaces with fire protection & electromechanical systems

lifeSafety.title: Architectural Life Safety and Means of Egress
lifeSafety.description: Review and design of architectural life-safety and means-of-egress requirements, including occupancy classification, occupant load, number and capacity of exits, travel distances, corridors, doors and escape stairs, emergency exits, fire-rated compartments and barriers, fire-resistance ratings, exit signage, safe accessibility provisions, and overall compliance of architectural drawings with applicable codes.
points: Occupancy classification & occupant load calculations
Number & capacity of exits, corridors & escape stairs
Fire-rated compartments, barriers & fire-resistance ratings
Exit signage, safe accessibility & architectural code compliance

smokeControl.title: Smoke Control and Smoke Exhaust System
smokeControl.description: Design and review of smoke-control and smoke-exhaust systems to remove smoke and heat and maintain tenable conditions during a fire, including smoke zones, exhaust rates, smoke-exhaust fans, ductwork, fire and smoke dampers, exhaust openings, make-up air provisions, control panels, sequence of operation, and interface with the fire alarm system.
points: Smoke zone demarcation & volumetric exhaust rate calculation
Smoke-exhaust fans, specialized ductwork & openings
Motorized fire and smoke dampers & make-up air provisions
Control panels, sequence of operation & fire alarm interface

ventilation.title: Mechanical Ventilation System
ventilation.description: Design and review of mechanical ventilation systems to provide the required air-change and fresh-air rates for occupied spaces, car parks, basements, technical rooms, and toilets, including airflow calculations, selection of fans, ductwork and air terminals, and verification of indoor air quality, operational performance, and applicable safety requirements.
points: Air-change and fresh-air rates for occupied spaces & car parks
Basement, technical room & sanitary facility ventilation
Airflow calculations, fan selection, ductwork & air terminals
Indoor air quality verification & operational safety compliance

pressurization.title: Stairwell and Escape Route Pressurization System
pressurization.description: Design and review of stairwell, corridor, or lobby pressurization systems to prevent smoke infiltration during a fire, including pressure differential and airflow-velocity calculations, leakage assessment, pressurization fan selection, pressure-relief provisions and ductwork, verification of acceptable door-opening forces, and integration with the fire alarm and emergency power systems.
points: Pressure differential & airflow-velocity engineering calculations
Leakage assessment, pressurization fan selection & ductwork
Pressure-relief provisions & door-opening force verification
Integration with fire alarm & emergency power systems

cfd.title: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) Analysis
cfd.description: Development of Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) models to simulate smoke, heat, and airflow under selected fire scenarios; assess smoke-control, smoke-exhaust, and ventilation performance; evaluate temperatures, visibility, gas concentrations, smoke-layer height, and air velocities; and compare required safe egress time with available safe egress time to verify compliance with the adopted performance and life-safety criteria.
points: 3D computerized simulation of smoke, heat & airflow scenarios
Temperature evaluation, visibility levels & gas concentrations
Smoke-layer height descent & air velocity verification
Required Safe Egress Time vs Available Safe Egress Time (RSET/ASET)
